record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare PRISMATIC_LASER: Necrozma (3 stars, range 1) and Ultra Necrozma (4 stars, range 3), both with passive PRISM (not covered) and maxPP 100. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index). The strategy does not read the caster's range.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage (raw [30, 40, 50, 60, 120] by caster stars: 50 for Necrozma, 60 for Ultra Necrozma) to every enemy-team unit in the three board columns centred on the CAST TARGET's column (target x-1, x, x+1; off-board columns skipped), over the full height of each column. After each hit, the enemy is pushed one cell along its column (toward y-1 for a RED_TEAM caster, toward y+1 otherwise) if that cell is on the board and empty and the enemy can be moved; the push is a forced displacement. Cells are scanned from the far end so a pushed unit lands on an already-scanned cell and is not hit twice.

targeting.who: every enemy-team entity on the board cells with x in {target.x - 1, target.x, target.x + 1} (within the board) and any y
targeting.note: The target only fixes the central column; it is hit because it stands in it (unless it is moved or removed first). Allies and empty cells are skipped. The scan reads each cell at the moment it is reached, after earlier pushes in the same column.

geometry.shape: three adjacent full-height board columns centred on the target's column; push direction along the column (y-1 for a RED caster, y+1 otherwise)

effects.target: each enemy-team unit in the three columns (each hit once)
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] per enemy hit, no falloff. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x (1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with a DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect (consumed by the first hit); x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 when the unit has protect / skydiving / magicBounce (see core-mechanics §A/§J). No heal, PP, shield or status is requested.

effects.target: each enemy hit, after its damage call

declaredRaw.label: requested displacement: one cell along the column

effects.scaling: fixed one cell; no AP, crit or star scaling.
effects.resolution: requested one cell; applied only if the next cell exists (0 <= newY < rows) and holds no entity, and moveTo(forcedDisplacement = true) does not return early: it is refused when the pushed entity cannot be moved (skydiving, locked, Heavy Duty Boots) or, for an occupied destination, when the occupant cannot be moved (the destination is empty by the guard). If applied, the entity goes to moving state (re-targets), the cells are swapped and its cooldown is set to 100. The push check follows the damage call whether or not the damage was blocked or the unit died.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars (3 and 4 for the listed units, bare factory values). The 5th table entry (120) equals the fallback and is reachable only at 5 stars. Range (1 vs 3) does not enter the strategy.

record.positionalConditions: Hit set depends on the cast target's column (x) and the board's column count; the push direction depends on the caster's team (RED_TEAM flips the scan and push direction). A pushed unit needs an empty cell ahead of it; a unit at the end of its column, or directly behind another unit, is not moved. Because the scan starts at the end toward which units are pushed, a column of adjacent units does not shift as a block.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and recomputes the columns from the current target position.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 50 (Necrozma) or 60 (Ultra Necrozma) per enemy in the three columns, displacement one cell. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage; a protect / skydiving / magicBounce unit takes none. Applied displacement is conditional on an empty on-board next cell and canBeMoved.
